prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Gates Enterprises** looks like a strong first call for Denver-area hail damage: its Denver-area listing highlights detailed inspections, photo documentation, and experience coordinating with insurers. It’s based in Lakewood and lists **(720) 766-3377**. [Gates Enterprises](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver)

I’d also get a comparison bid from **Red Hawk Roofing**, which serves Denver and advertises hail-damage work, licensing, insurance, and a workmanship warranty. [Red Hawk Roofing](https://redhawkroofing.com/service-areas/denver)

Before signing, get at least two written estimates, verify the contractor’s current license and insurance, and make sure the contract spells out materials, scope, warranty, and payment terms. Be cautious of anyone pressuring you to sign immediately or promising to “cover” your insurance deductible.
